objective: Implement synthetic-only native-source application configuration, preflight, control, authenticated admission, durable evidence, status, scope removal, audit, and Review routing without implementing later-slice execution or live Apple behavior.
out_of_scope: live Apple frameworks, accounts, permissions, credentials, or personal data
TCC, entitlements, signing, notarization, installation, or watcher activation
baseline and incremental execution owned by Slices E and F
gateway, MCP, CLI, or frontend exposure owned by Slice G
live activation and operational proof owned by Slice H
source mutation, external-model disclosure, deployment, production, destruction, or risk acceptance
limitations: The corrected exact head still requires independent review and a green GitHub PR CI rerun before merge.
The final zero-write admission correction passed locally against isolated PostgreSQL and still requires a green PR CI rerun and independent exact-head review.
Removing the final selected bucket is rejected because the Slice B exact-selection invariant requires at least one bucket; full configuration retirement remains deferred.
Native capabilities are deliberately unavailable on legacy MCP, HTTP, and CLI transports until Slice G.
Control commands authorize and receipt state transitions only; they do not execute Slice E/F jobs or watchers.
failed_attempts: A global expansion of the legacy Capability enum broke closed-set transport and readiness contracts; corrected by introducing a separate NativeSourceCapability union at policy and audit boundaries.
Infrastructure initially imported application protocol types, violating dependency direction; corrected with application-owned protocols and infrastructure-owned structural records.
A broad path-based run accidentally selected database tests without MY_PA_DATABASE_URL and produced 268 environment setup errors; no database was accessed or created.
The first corrected non-database run found an audit annotation whose named type alias obscured its closed enum union; corrected to an explicit union and rerun clean.
The virtualenv had no YAML parser, so the combined artifact-parse command stopped before tests; checkpoint JSON and the 48 matrix rows were instead validated with dependency-free repository checks.

An initial mechanical matrix patch placed status values on preceding criteria; exact 48-row verification caught it, all eleven intended rows were corrected, and every non-C row was rechecked unchanged.

The first corrective D contract invocation compiled but its lock probe resolved the external scratch executable relative to the repository; rerunning from /private/tmp with an absolute package path passed all ten checks.

The first corrective broad run passed 2946 tests but exposed three stale closed-set declarations for the new tables and authority identifier; the exact vocabulary owners were reconciled and the full run then passed 2949 tests.
A combined read-only static closeout command was rejected by the execution approval policy before it started; no check ran and no file changed, so the checks were rerun as smaller invocations.
The split checkpoint parse invoked an unavailable unqualified python command; the repository virtualenv interpreter was used instead.

A command-substitution form of the final read-only SHA manifest was rejected by the execution approval policy before it started; the same fixed 26-path manifest was computed without command substitution.

PR CI run 30983415715 exposed six database-tier failures and 25 fixture errors: historical assertions omitted the three newer Slice C tables, head vocabulary omitted the separate native capability enum, one source-visibility assertion conflated source scope with selected configuration, and audit fixtures truncated a referenced table without its new dependent authority table. The bounded corrections passed the exact 466-test local database tier.

The PR source review found that preflight did not bind the returned request ID and indexed results only by bucket locator. Exact request and composite-locator regressions now pass, with no configuration, preflight-status, or authority write on a mismatched response.

The corrected-manifest review found that admission status committed before response acceptance and final current-scope validation. Reachable status now commits atomically with final authority validation, consumption, and evidence; identity-mismatched and concurrently revoked admissions leave zero durable admission effects. The first new isolated-database invocation could not start because MY_PA_DATABASE_URL was not configured. A separate auto-removed PostgreSQL 17 container was then created on loopback with tmpfs/trust, the full Slice C admission file passed 10 tests, and the exact database/recovery/e2e tier passed 467 tests with 2,953 deselected.
